args.message:
Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)

Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead of ROUND_HALF_UP when quantizing to cents,
matching the FIN-212 requirement and the test expectations.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the FIN-212 requirement (and the docstring) calls for banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` (sha `08d3cd5986`) passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212`.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
